Julien Tierny - Visualization Exercise - Isosurface Extraction
The naive way The naive algorithm for isosurface extraction consists in: · looping over the entire list of tetrahedra of the input tet-mesh, and for each tetrahedron: · computing, if it exists, the polygon which intersects the tetrahedron along the level set; · adding the vertices and the faces of that polygon to the output isosurface.
